body_markdown:
Hello Samuel,


I noticed my CNBC feed has not been fetching properly since Thursday, 11/19. Previously, the feed would fetch stories every five to 10 minutes. I woke up on Friday, 11/20 to no new stories. I manually fetched the feed, and stories came pouring in. The feed has been stuck at fetching every “12 to 15 hours” since then. This is an unacceptable refresh period. It is extremely annoying to have to manually fetch stories dozens of times per day. This feed has behaved properly for years before this. How do we get it back to fetching every five to 10 minutes again? Thank you for your assistance.


Feed URL:[https://search.cnbc.com/rs/search/combinedcms/view.xml?id=100003114&partnerId=wrss01](https://search.cnbc.com/rs/search/combinedcms/view.xml?id=100003114&partnerId=wrss01)
